reply.text:
Hormone therapy is a medical treatment, so what estrogen does to your body, your recovery and your strength over time is one for your prescriber or an endocrinologist, not a coach. They can speak to your own labs and timeline, which I can't.

On my side, I can build your training around what you want from it: your goals, your schedule, the equipment you have, and how you're recovering session to session. If you tell me what you're after and how many days you can train, I'll set up a program for you.
